items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Crème fraîche' to USDA Foundation 'Cream, sour, full fat' through a retained exact evidence record. Crème fraîche is a cultured high-fat cream and full-fat sour cream is the closest pinned USDA cultured-cream identity available in the offline reference corpus. The words 'thick' and 'full-fat' describe texture/fat level rather than a different ingredient family. Confidence remains medium because crème fraîche is typically richer and less tangy than U.S. sour cream, so the selected record is a nutrient-profile approximation within the same cultured-cream family; this decision does not generalize to cooking cream, heavy cream, yogurt, quark, or cream cheese.
